brief: A three-storey cabinet with at least three drawers.

requirements.evidence: Pieces at q0,0 and q1,0 and q0,1 at levels 0,1,2 (9 pieces total) with vertical snaps, forming a three-level structure. check_build confirms meshClash clear.

Three notch drawer frames hex-drawer-frame-notch-mf installed at (1,1) level 0, level 1, level 2 (notch:0#1,1#notch2, notch:1#1#notch2, notch:2#1,1#notch2) – each provides a drawer, stacked vertically on three storeys.

finish.summary: Built 3-storey (levels 0-2) L-shaped cabinet of 9 hex bases with 3 vertically stacked notch drawer frames at 1,1, providing three drawers. Mesh check clear.

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
